name: Keio University
description: Keio University is a private university in Tokyo, founded in 1858 by Fukuzawa Yukichi and Japan's oldest institution of modern higher education. It has ten undergraduate faculties spanning the humanities, social sciences, science and technology, and medicine.
whyIncluded: Keio offers two all-English undergraduate degree programmes (PEARL in the Faculty of Economics and GIGA at its Shonan Fujisawa Campus), the Public Service Commission places scholars in Japan, and Japan is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in UNESCO UIS data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: Keio SFC (Shonan Fujisawa Campus) housing page, 'Off-campus Housing Example (per month)' for international students, total ¥145,000: housing = rent ¥60,000 + utilities/internet ¥15,000; food ¥30,000; transport ¥10,000; personal = phone ¥5,000 + books ¥5,000 + hobbies ¥7,000 + others ¥10,000. Insurance ¥3,000 excluded. The page is undated (read 2026-09-30) and says students should budget about ¥120,000-150,000 a month; Mita/Yagami campuses in central Tokyo are likely dearer.

programmes.name: Faculty of Science and Technology
programmes.notes: AY 2026 Academic Fees and Expenses for Undergraduate Faculties (first-year row). Tuition = 授業料. Compulsory fees = registration fee ¥70,000 + facilities fee ¥260,000 + experiment/practical training fee ¥120,000 + student government fee ¥750 + health mutual-aid ¥2,600 (includes a ¥100 one-time registration). One-off = admission fee ¥200,000. Registration, tuition, facilities and lab fees rise yearly on a sliding scale, so not cohort-locked. Japanese-taught; the English-taught International Graduate Programs are at master's level. 2025 figures from the AY 2025 undergraduate fee table (Japanese): tuition ¥1,390,000, facilities ¥250,000 + lab ¥120,000, other fees ¥3,350.

programmes.name: School of Medicine
programmes.notes: AY 2026 Academic Fees and Expenses for Undergraduate Faculties (first-year row). Tuition = 授業料 ¥3,040,000 (the same in years 2-6 for the 2026 cohort's row, subject to the sliding scale). Compulsory fees = registration fee ¥70,000 + facilities fee ¥420,000 + experiment/practical training fee ¥220,000 + student government fee ¥750 + health mutual-aid ¥2,600 (includes a ¥100 one-time registration). One-off = admission fee ¥200,000. Registration, tuition, facilities and lab fees rise yearly on a sliding scale, so not cohort-locked. 6-year undergraduate medical degree, Japanese-taught. Not on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications (1 Sep 2022 edition). 2025 figures from the AY 2025 undergraduate fee table (Japanese): tuition ¥3,040,000, facilities ¥410,000 + lab ¥220,000, other fees ¥3,350.

programmes.name: Law School, Major in Legal Practice (Juris Doctor)
programmes.notes: AY 2026 Law School Professional Degree Programs fee table, 2026 entrants row (1年･未修; the 2-year track for law graduates has the same annual fees). Tuition = 授業料 ¥1,220,000. Compulsory fees = registration fee (在籍料) ¥330,000 + facilities fee ¥210,000 + Keio Law journal subscription ¥8,000 + health mutual-aid ¥2,600 (includes a ¥100 one-time registration). One-off = admission fee ¥100,000. Registration, tuition and facilities fees rise yearly on a sliding scale, so not cohort-locked. Standard duration 3 years (2 years for students entering with a law degree). Japanese-taught professional degree preparing for the Japanese bar; Keio also runs an English-taught LL.M. in Global Legal Practice at ¥1,790,000. 2025 figures from the AY 2025 Law School fee table (Japanese): tuition ¥1,180,000, registration ¥320,000, facilities ¥210,000, other fees ¥12,240, admission ¥100,000.
